messages:
Priya S.: Kicking off thread — ACME Retail reconfirming POC deliverables. They want embeddings + rerank for product search, streaming summarization for long reviews, BYO KMS for PII. Target p99 search latency <350ms, expected peak ~120 qps. 2-week eval then pilot. Can we align success criteria and call out blockers?

Jordan (SE): Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: dataset size? number of docs? avg tokens per query? SSE/VPC requirements?

Priya S.: Dataset ~= 5M product descriptions + ~10M reviews. Avg query ~25 tokens. Freshness daily. VPC + BYO KMS required.

Marco R.: Pricing note from buyer: will they need Dedicated from day one? They explicitly asked for reserved throughput for holiday spikes and cost for streaming summarization.

Alice Chen: Technical read: for 120 qps with p99 <350ms we'll likely need Dedicated or high-priority reserved capacity + prefix/KV caching. Embeddings + rerank is throughput-heavy at index time but cheap at query time if cached. Streaming summarization is more sensitive to tail latency — batching hurts UX. BYO KMS adds egress & setup time (~2-3 days) and extra validation.

Jordan (SE): Draft success criteria (proposal):
1) Rerank/search: top-5 MRR >= 0.78 on our sample eval set
2) p99 search latency <= 350ms at 120 qps sustained for 1 hour on dedicated test harness
3) streaming summarization: end-to-end <= 2s for avg 150-token input (90th percentile)
4) Security: BYO KMS integrated and key rotation verified; SOC checklist items signed off
Please comment.

Priya S.: LGTM. Add cost acceptance: buyer wants a rough unit cost per 1M queries/tokens to validate economics.

Marco R.: I can provide a pricing band: Dedicated reserved tier + streaming add-on — will produce estimate tomorrow. Need to call out potential uplift for HSM / compliance.

Alice Chen: Blockers to flag to the buyer: their infra team said dev environment must be egress-disabled. If they insist on on-prem/offline for the trial, timeline moves to 4–6 weeks. Alternative: run a private trial in their cloud with our Private control plane + BYO KMS which shortens to ~2 weeks but requires infra IAM work.

Jordan (SE): Quick sample eval prompt set (will expand):
```
# eval_prompt_set.jsonl
{"query":"waterproof hiking boots","relevant_ids":["p123","p456"],"candidate_ids":["p234","p123","p456","p789"]}
{"query":"cordless drill battery life","relevant_ids":["p777","p888"],"candidate_ids":["p888","p999","p777"]}
```
Use this to compute MRR/precision@k.

Priya S.: Action items:
- Jordan: assemble full eval prompt set + sample queries by EOD today
- Alice: run perf sim for 120 qps across our recommended model variants and share perf envelope (48 hrs)
- Marco: price shading + contract note re: Dedicated requirement (tomorrow)
- Priya: coordinate SOC/security questionnaire answers and request infra constraints doc from customer

Alice Chen: FYI: customer just sent updated security addendum — they require HSM-backed keys for production. HSM increases integration verification time; recommend noting as dependency in the SOW.

Marco R.: Noted. I'll mark HSM as a conditional blocker for pilot start and include optional pricing line for HSM-enabled Dedicated.

salesbot: Reminder: create POC ticket in CRM (#POC-8921) and attach this thread + eval artifacts.

Priya S.: Thanks all. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PT — please bring perf numbers, cost ranges, and a proposed prompt/eval set. @Jordan (SE) @Alice Chen @Marco R.
